neighbours.label: a measurement or tracer used to estimate something in science (isotope dating such as argon-argon, indicator organisms, biomarkers), at the method word
fire: The age of the volcanic ash was found with the potassium-argon method, which relies on steady decay.
Water samples were tested for fecal indicator bacteria such as E. coli to estimate contamination.
Levels of mercury in hair can be used as a biomarker of long-term exposure to fish.
Geologists dated the lava flows using argon-argon dating of the feldspar crystals.
Radiocarbon dating estimates the age of bones based on the fixed decay rate of carbon-14.
Tree rings serve as a proxy for past rainfall, letting researchers estimate ancient droughts.
The isotope Argon-40 accumulates in rocks as potassium decays over millions of years.
Cotinine in saliva is used as a marker to estimate how much smoke a child inhaled.
quiet: The volcanic ash covered the village and the farmers had to leave their fields for a year.
Water samples were collected from the river every Monday by volunteers from the school.
Mercury in fish is a common worry for families who eat seafood several times a week.
Geologists walked along the lava flows and photographed the strange black rocks.
The museum displayed old bones from the cave next to a model of the ancient village.
Tree rings are visible on a freshly cut stump, and children like to count them.
Noble gases are used in lighting because they glow brightly when electricity passes through.
Saliva helps us digest food and keeps the mouth moist throughout the day.
